stories.headline: U.P. Election 2027: New Owaisi-Azad Front Puts Opposition Vote Equation In Focus
stories.title: U.P. Election 2027: New Owaisi-Azad Front Puts Opposition Vote Equation In Focus
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh's political battle for 2027 has a new player. AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi and Azad Samaj Party (Kanshiram) president Chandrashekhar Azad have joined hands to form the Samajik Parivartan Morcha, announcing their alliance in Lucknow on Thursday. Owaisi has named Chandrashekhar Azad as the alliance's chief ministerial candidate, while the two leaders say the front will contest all 403 Assembly seats. The alliance has also invited the Samajwadi Party and Congress to join its campaign against the BJP. But its Dalit-Muslim political pitch raises questions about the existing support bases of the SP, BSP and Congress — and the possibility of Opposition votes being divided. With rival leaders already questioning the alliance, what could this new formation mean for Uttar Pradesh's electoral arithmetic?

stories.headline: Manipur’s Ambekar Meetei wins India’s first-ever Youth Olympics boxing gold
stories.title: Manipur’s Ambekar Meetei wins India’s first-ever Youth Olympics boxing gold
stories.summary: The Manipur boxer makes history at Dakar 2026, winning India’s first-ever Youth Olympics boxing gold with a 3-2 victory over Ireland.
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
article_sentences: DAKAR: Lairenlakpam Ambekar Meetei created history by winning India’s first-ever Youth Olympics gold medal in boxing at the ongoing edition in Dakar, Senegal, on Thursday.
Ambekar defeated Ireland’s Kristian Jubani 3-2 in the men’s 50kg final.
Ambekar’s triumph marks a landmark moment for Indian boxing at the Youth Olympics, with Shiva Thapa’s (60kg) silver medal at the 2010 Games being the country’s previous best performance in the sport.

stories.headline: India's retail inflation hits two-year high of 6.09% as food prices rise
stories.title: India's retail inflation hits two-year high of 6.09% as food prices rise
stories.summary: India's retail inflation surged to a two-year high of 6.09% in October 2026, driven by food inflation at 8.94%. Rising prices of essentials like onions and sugar, coupled with erratic weather and global commodity pressures, breached the RBI's tolerance limit, highlighting sharper inflation in rural areas compared to urban regions.

stories.headline: Adani Energy acquires smart metering player IntelliSmart for ₹3,050 crore
stories.title: Adani Energy acquires smart metering player IntelliSmart for ₹3,050 crore
stories.summary: Adani Energy Solutions on Friday said it has acquired IntelliSmart Infrastructure from National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIIF) and Energy Efficiency Services Limited (EESL) for Rs 3,050 crore, a move that will boost the Adani Group entity's presence in the smart metering space. The Rs 3,050-crore transaction includes the acquisition of 100 per cent equity share capital of IntelliSmart and redemption of the optionally convertible debentures of IntelliSmart held by NIIF. IntelliSmart Infrastructure provides advanced metering infrastructure for electricity and deploys certain smart gas meters in the country. In an exchange filing, Adani Energy Solutions Ltd (AESL) said it has completed the acquisition of 100 per cent of the equity share capital of IntelliSmart from NIIF and EESL, and the optionally convertible debentures of IntelliSmart held by NIIF have been redeemed. On October 30, the fair trade regulator, the Competition Commission of India (CCI), approved Adani Energy

stories.headline: Trump threatens Mexico with doubled tariffs as nearly 2,000 migrants head towards US border
stories.title: Trump threatens Mexico with doubled tariffs as nearly 2,000 migrants head towards US border
stories.summary: Nearly 2,000 migrants head to the US border as Trump warns of Mexico tariffs if the caravan advances, fueling immigration and policy tensions
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
article_sentences: Nearly 2,000 migrants from Central and South America are heading towards the US southern border following the Democrats' gains in the midterm elections, with US President Donald Trump threatening to immediately double tariffs on Mexico if it fails to stop the caravan from reaching American territory.

In a post on Truth Social on Thursday (local time), Trump linked the formation of new migrant caravans to the Republicans' performance in the midterm elections, claiming that the movement was taking place following the party's electoral losses.
With the perceived loss by the Republicans in the Midterms - I was not on the ballot- the invasion of our Country is taking place again.
Huge caravans are forming and beginning their illegal march through Mexico.
Many of the people in these Caravans are those that various countries don’t want - “Send them to America,” they say - But they will not be accepted!”
He warned, "Mexico must stop them now, and if they do not do so, the Tariffs on Mexico will be immediately doubled.
Mexico, the Governor of Texas, the very liberal new Governor of Texas, our great Border Patrol & ICE, have been so informed.
Thank you for your attention to this matter."
Fox News reported that migrants travelling with the caravan expected the Democrats to welcome them and provide opportunities to build new lives in the United States.
One migrant told Fox News, "We are seeing it this way because we know that the Democrats are not going to let a point as big as the Latino vote be lost.
